title: feat(ui): unify plugin discovery and installation

commit.messageHeadline: feat(ui): unify plugin catalog discovery
fix(ui): align plugin catalog card and audit presentation
fix(ui): polish plugin controls and iconography
feat: recommend official ClawHub capabilities through message
feat(ui): show ClawHub install cards in chat
fix(ui): align ClawHub chat card plugin icon
fix(ui): use shared OpenClaw styles for ClawHub chat cards
fix: guide capability requests through available ClawHub cards
test(codex): type capability prompt tool fixtures
fix(ui): complete unified plugin catalog
fix(ui): load ClawHub card artwork with skeletons
test(gateway): cover catalog package identity
test(ui): remove stale plugin viewport import
fix(plugins): preserve catalog provenance and audit trust
test(plugins): bind catalog join fixture to ClawHub identity
fix(plugins): decouple inspection from catalog latency
refactor(ui): keep plugin marketplace page within lint bounds
fix(plugins): keep optional catalog reads off hot paths
fix(ui): preserve complete plugin catalog access
test(ui): remove retired plugin inventory fixtures
fix(ui): harden plugin catalog landing invariants
test(ui): register plugin config fixture copy
test(ui): synchronize plugin gateway restart proof

- valid entries with missing or unavailable category metadata remain visible in an honest, uncapped **Uncategorized** shelf;

Final exact-head landing update for `4d86fb4baea`:

- Repaired the prior CI failure: duplicate ClawHub outage banners are now one grouped, retryable warning.
- Closed final review invariants: failed/repeated catalog cursors stop auto-following but remain explicitly retryable; restart completion requires a new Gateway boot ID; cancelled/failed wizard configuration cannot leak into global settings; failed-save Retry preserves the draft; explicit JSON `null` and key deletion remain distinct via a base-hash-guarded `config.set`; canonical package identity prevents local/remote duplicates.
- Validation: 86 focused Gateway/catalog/UI tests pass; plugin mocked-Gateway E2E passes 15/15; UI production and test typechecks pass; changed-file formatting, type-aware lint, and whitespace checks pass. Independent P0/P1 audit is clean.
- Full local `check:changed` passed every applicable core/UI/extension/type/lint/deadcode gate and stopped only at Android ktlint because this host has no Java runtime; GitHub CI owns that platform lane.

Compatibility dispositions: no config/default, database/schema, persistence, protocol-version, or migration surface is added. PRs 12–14 are intended for atomic stack deployment so the category data and unified renderer cannot be observed in an intermediate combination.

Exact head is now `d69b0ff5f10`. The only post-audit change is the generated Control UI raw-copy baseline entry for the intentional test-fixture label `Mode`; `pnpm ui:i18n:verify` passes locally. No production behavior changed after the clean review.
